title: The Snug Cap
sentences: Dad had a black cap at the club.
Skip had a plan to get Dad a red cap.
Skip and Mom went to a shop with cash.
A man had a red cap to sell.
Skip gave him the cash and got the red cap.
Skip and Mom went back to Dad.
Skip gave Dad the red cap.
Dad gave the black cap to Skip.

comprehensionQuestion.question: What did the man give Skip for the cash?
